messages.subject: Banpu | Mining, power, energy technology and international stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Banpu Executive Leadership Team,

Banpu stands out because its portfolio spans the same transition I have experienced firsthand: from resource operations toward power, cleaner energy systems and technology-led decarbonization.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy for a major gold-mining operation.

I would bring Banpu direct mining-sector credibility combined with energy-transition execution. My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, carbon-data readiness using physical operating records, community and social-performance priorities, and multi-agency regulatory coordination. I understand the operating realities behind a transition narrative.

I am interested in Thailand, regional or international mandates across ESG, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or energy-transition stakeholder strategy. I have attached a Banpu-focused executive CV and would appreciate your sharing it with the appropriate executive or talent leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
